**score 35.7** ±3.9 · #291 of 361 · from 2 benchmark results across 2 sources · \* thinly tested, treat the rank as provisional

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma-3n/model_card): Publisher advertises 32K total context, shared between input and output. Stored as the stated rounded 32K; no unsupported 32,768-token precision inferred.</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~3.76GB   35.7
8-bit q8_0    ~7.03GB   35.7
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run gemma3n:e2b
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run gemma3n:e2b-it-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
